coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 1401 Third Street
record.summary: A five-story, roughly 222,000 sq ft commercial office building at 1401 Third Street in Mission Bay South. DataSF's Assessor tax roll (block 8721, lot 032) records the building's construction year as 2009.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8721032), address confirmed via DataSF Assessor parcel data (blklot 8721032) and real-estate listing sources; not a hand trace or plan estimate. open_questions: Developer, architect and current/original tenant not confirmed by any source found in this pass -- consistent with this record's own geometry-file note.
Precise completion month not available; DataSF's Assessor tax roll gives only a year.

The permit's own block/lot (block 8721, lot 012) at filing time differs from the lot the Assessor now uses for this address (lot 032); Mission Bay parcels were renumbered after the original 2000s-era permits were filed, and the address, description (5-story office/lab), scale and 2008-04-24 permit-completion date all line up with this parcel, so this is treated as a lot renumbering, not a different building.
